candidate_practices.name: Name the requirement being replaced
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts distinguish methods through a changed training dependency or architectural requirement.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: a concrete substitution makes novelty assessable without priority claims.
candidate_practices.application: Write: prior approach requires X; ours uses Y; report the capability retained.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: When the requirement remains elsewhere in the pipeline.

support.specific_example: Q-RAG moves fine-tuning from small LLMs to an RL-trained embedder.
LongWriter-Zero describes base-model RL without annotated or synthetic training data.
ABOM replaces predefined task distributions with online target-population feedback.
WAFT substitutes high-resolution warping for cost volumes.

contrasts.contrast: RodriNet adds kinematic structure; removing specialized structure is not a universal improvement.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Residual dependencies, matched comparisons, and whether the substitution explains gains.

candidate_practices.name: Anchor efficiency to a retained capability
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts pair resource changes with quality or capability conditions.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: the pairing identifies what the resource saving buys or preserves.
candidate_practices.application: State the resource, reference system, retained outcome, and comparison condition together.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: When resource and quality results come from incomparable settings.

support.specific_example: ThinKV reports near-lossless accuracy below 5% of original cache usage.
FlashVID reports retained performance at 10% tokens and additional frames under equal compute.
FALCON compares speed with an equivalently performing CNF.
Πnet qualifies solver comparisons by modest accuracy and distinguishes single problems from batches.

contrasts.contrast: HSD claims provable distribution preservation, a different standard from empirical near-lossless quality.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Hardware, quality tolerances, denominators, workload matching, and guarantee assumptions.

candidate_practices.name: Define a resource through its missing evaluation conditions
candidate_practices.source_observation: These benchmark abstracts specify task or environment conditions absent from earlier evaluations.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: this explains why the resource changes measurement, beyond adding examples.
candidate_practices.application: Name the omitted condition, its representation in the resource, and the resulting evaluation question.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: When deliberately isolating a narrow capability makes environmental realism irrelevant.

support.specific_example: AstaBench combines scientific tasks, search infrastructure, and agent baselines.
SimuHome adds evolving environmental effects and accelerated workflow evaluation.
EditBench includes in-the-wild instructions, highlighting, cursor state, and context-sensitive outcomes.
WebDevJudge combines static and interactive assessment with rubric-grounded human preferences.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Sampling, annotation reliability, simulator fidelity, controls, and metric definitions.

candidate_practices.name: Make a diagnosis observable before prescribing a remedy
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts expose intermediate dependencies or behaviors rather than reporting only aggregate success.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: diagnostic observations can distinguish explanations and motivate targeted changes.
candidate_practices.application: Name the suspected failure, the observable or perturbation, and the specific resulting finding.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: When the probe changes the task or its signal admits unresolved alternative explanations.

support.specific_example: Graph inference probes features, edges, and labels; code-generation advantages are tied to token-constrained regimes.
MC-Search uses step annotations and process metrics to identify retrieval and modality-planning failures.
TRACE operationalizes effort through reward at progressively truncated reasoning lengths.
Collaborative Battleship separates answering, information gain, and targeting outcomes.

contrasts.contrast: CRV additionally reports feature interventions correcting errors; predictive diagnosis alone does not establish that intervention claim.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Probe validity, alternative explanations, intervention controls, and diagnostic effect sizes.

candidate_practices.name: Attach theorem claims to their operative regime
candidate_practices.source_observation: These theory abstracts distinguish assumptions, extensions, and computational conclusions.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: localizing conditions prevents a headline from becoming an unconditional claim.
candidate_practices.application: Place the regime beside the conclusion; separately state what an extension changes.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Do not invent multiple regimes when only one is analyzed.

support.specific_example: Softmax completeness separates restricted languages from arbitrary languages requiring relative positions.
InfoNCE Gaussianity separates alignment/concentration assumptions from a regularization-assisted regime.
MDM equivalence uses finite precision and log width; efficiency advantages concern specified problem classes.
Federated complexity comparisons follow an explicit strategy-dependent cost model.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Definitions, theorem quantifiers, proof correctness, rates, and correspondence to implementations.

candidate_practices.name: Translate an explanation into an operational consequence
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts connect structural accounts to algorithms, schedules, or cheaper representations.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: the connection shows what an explanation changes in author or practitioner decisions.
candidate_practices.application: Follow the explanatory claim with the computation it enables, then distinguish supporting evidence from interpretation.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: When the explanation has no established operational consequence.

support.specific_example: Exchangeability leads to order-statistic Euclidean comparisons and graph LSH.
SGF connects a unified potential to a critical guidance window and early-denoising findings.
RALI targets RL-derived text representations directly to omit inference-time reasoning.
Diffusion boundary cues are extracted and distilled into a one-step decoder.

contrasts.contrast: Early-training weight decompositions contribute explanation without requiring a replacement system.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Validity of the explanatory account and whether the operational change depends on it.

candidate_practices.name: Explain component roles without inventing isolated effects
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts describe coordinated mechanisms serving distinct or coupled goals.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: explicit roles make multiple contributions coherent without asserting unsupported attribution.
candidate_practices.application: Replace a component list with intended functions and interactions; reserve causal language for demonstrated effects.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: When assigning separate roles would misrepresent an inseparable mechanism.

support.specific_example: WAVE jointly presents fusion and multimodal multitask training for retrieval and prompt awareness.
AgentFlow separates system modules from trajectory-linked planner optimization.
Mamba-3 assigns expressiveness, state tracking, and latency aims to three changes.
CoCo combines local/global views, low-rank embeddings, and consistency learning.

contrasts.contrast: One progressive-stratification procedure addresses both multiple testing and entanglement; mappings need not be one-to-one.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Component interactions, attribution evidence, and discrepancies between intended and measured effects.

unusual_but_useful.application: Separate structure/quality comparisons from sample-diversity comparisons.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Separate explicit control from configuration assistance.
unusual_but_useful.application: Explain user primitives and inferred settings separately.
unusual_but_useful.limit: Code length does not establish usability.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Pair formal scope with the consequential tuning variable.
unusual_but_useful.application: Name covered schedules, merge-duration sensitivity, and annealing-data condition.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Connect an integration model to a transfer diagnostic.
unusual_but_useful.application: State what geometric consistency measures before interpreting scaling.
unusual_but_useful.limit: Dataset-count associations do not establish causality.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Specify interaction capability beyond output duration.
unusual_but_useful.application: Report speaker capacity alongside timing and annotation design.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Distinguish faster progress from a higher endpoint.
unusual_but_useful.application: State whether an intervention changes compute efficiency or estimated asymptote.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Turn a tradeoff into an objective and constraint.
unusual_but_useful.application: Identify proxies before stating the constrained update.
unusual_but_useful.limit: Proxy satisfaction need not imply retained knowledge or plasticity.

unusual_but_useful.application: Connect each learning phase to its predicted observable and exponent.
unusual_but_useful.limit: Phase boundaries and numerical agreement are unavailable.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Justify a metric by downstream predictiveness.
unusual_but_useful.application: Define coverage and the cross-entropy prediction problem it addresses.
unusual_but_useful.limit: Necessity and sufficiency require theorem conditions.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Match generalization tests to an omitted variable.
unusual_but_useful.application: Connect camera conditioning to cross-camera evaluation.
unusual_but_useful.limit: Reported gains do not establish universal prerequisite status.
